svg.title: dwago: ask your codebase anything
svg.desc: Pixel-art project card for dwago, an open source Python tool (Apache-2.0, tree-sitter) that runs locally. A pixel brain map shows files as square neurons grouped into lobes (auth, api, billing, db), imports as dotted wiring and gold sparkles on churn hotspots. Example query: ask "how do we prevent double charging?". A reticle locks onto src/billing/charge.py, where a pixel bug is caught, lightning strikes run along its import edges to connected files and an answer chip cites src/billing/charge.py:142. The bug is zapped and drops a coin. Then impact src/auth/session.ts, and co-change src/db/store.ts drawn as gold arcs from git history. Illustrative example output.

g.text: HOW DO WE PREVENT DOUBLE CHARGING?
